gaps: totalDebt: null for FY2007, FY2008, FY2009, FY2010, FY2011, FY2012, FY2013, FY2014, FY2015, FY2016, FY2017, FY2018, FY2019, FY2020, FY2021, FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 - Tencent publishes Borrowings and Notes payable as separate lines in its net-cash table (e.g. FY2025: borrowings RMB250,987m, notes payable RMB136,746m) but no total-debt figure; not summed per brief
notes: IFRS throughout. Reporting currency RMB (CNY). Figures in RMB'000 until FY2012 and RMB million from FY2013 in the reports; scaled to units.

Revenue, net income (profit attributable to equity holders), total assets and equity attributable to equity holders taken from the five-year Financial Summary of AR2010 (FY2007-2010, FY2008 balance sheet restated), AR2015 (FY2011-2015, RMB million), AR2020 (FY2016-2020) and AR2025 (FY2021-2025).

operatingIncome: Tencent changed its definition of operating profit in 2023 (investment-related gains/losses moved out of operating profit); FY2019-FY2022 use the restated figures from the AR2023/AR2025 Financial Summary. FY2018 and earlier are as originally published and include 'other gains/losses, net', so they are not comparable with FY2019+.
Share subdivision 1:5 effective May 2014: dilutedEPS, dividendPerShare and sharesOutstanding for FY2007-FY2013 are pre-split as originally published (AR2014 restates FY2013 diluted EPS to RMB1.660).
dividendPerShare is the final dividend recommended for the year, declared in HKD (not RMB). Special/in-specie distributions (e.g. Meituan and JD shares) are excluded.

capex = 'Purchase of fixed assets / property, plant and equipment, construction in progress and investment properties' (from FY2024 the line reads 'Purchase of/prepayments for ...'); intangible asset and land-use-right purchases are separate lines and are excluded.
sharesOutstanding = issued shares per the share capital note (Group) at 31 December.
OCF FY2007 (1,835,704k) and FY2018 (110,936m) and capex FY2011 are the restated comparatives from the following year's report.
